verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents structured relational data with typed columns, relationships and indexes in its managed databases. It also offers a dedicated native PostgreSQL database you connect to directly via psql, Prisma or Drizzle, which implies SQL joins, constraints and transactions. However, the evidence never explicitly documents join queries, constraint enforcement or transaction APIs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of joins, constraints (foreign keys/unique) and transaction support, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
